Laravel 12/PHP 8.2; React 19/TypeScript; Mantine 7.17/Tailwind 4; Inertia.js 2 (SSR); Filament 3.3; SQLite; Vite 6; PHPUnit 11.5; Pint, ESLint, Prettier; Tabler Icons, Ziggy, Carbon. Use Laravel–React SPA, SSR, typed components, Breeze auth, Filament admin.

Read the corresponding Markdown task before every implementation decision. Tasks: `backlog/tasks/`; drafts: `backlog/drafts/`; docs: `backlog/docs/`; decisions: `backlog/decisions/`. All task operations should be done via Backlog.md CLI tool, this will correctly update the metadata in the task files and keep the project in sync. NO OPERATIONS SHOULD BE DONE MANUALLY ON THE TASK FILES. Always use `--plain` flag when listing or viewing tasks for AI-friendly text output instead of using Backlog.md. Ask questions if unclear; split large work into atomic, testable, single-PR tasks. ACs describe measurable, verifiable outcomes, not implementation steps. Never reference tasks that are to be done in the future or that are not yet created. You can only reference tasks (id < current task id). Create dependencies foundation-first; tasks must be independent.
